sn11.23:1.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo ābādhiko ahosi dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 4.
sn11.23:1.4: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo yena Vepacitti asurindo ten-upasaṅkami gilānapucchako || || 5.
sn11.23:1.5: Addasā kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam dūrato va āgacchantam ||
sn11.23:1.6: disvāna Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || ||
sn11.23:1.10: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo asure paṭipucchi || ||
sn11.23:1.11: Vācem-aham marisā Sakkam devānam indaṃ sambarimāyan ti || || 9.
sn11.23:1.12: Mā kho tvaṃ mārisa vacesi Sakkam devānam indam sambarimāyan ti || || 10.
sn11.23:1.13: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
